text.text: Cisco Integrated System for Microsoft Azure Stack

graphic.text: Cisco Integrated System for Microsoft Azure Stack

text.text: The Cisco Integrated System for Microsoft Azure Stack is a co-engineered solutions that enables you to run the Azure public cloud within your datacenter. This enables the user to see the same user interface as if they were using the Azure Public Cloud, while the developer can exercise the same Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) for Azure Stack as they would for Azure. Customers who have data sovereignty, regulatory, connection latency, or heritage application issues should consider the advantages that the Cisco Integrated System for Microsoft Azure Stack provides.

text.text: The two Nexus 9000 are the top of rack switches which enable connectivity to your data center’s border switches. Currently, Microsoft support a direct point to point L3 connectivity with a choice of with BGP or Static Routing for the protocol. Each switch maintains a copy of the configuration of the other switch to enable quick replacement should a failure occur. Nexus continues to be the standard for network connectivity in data centers around the world. The Cisco Nexus 9336C-FX2 Switch supports: Powered by Cloud Scale Technology 1rack unit (1RU) 40 MB buffer Up to 7.2 TBps of bandwidth 36 x 40/100 Gbps QSFP28 ports Automated, policy-based systems management with Cisco ACI Cisco Tetration support with built-in hardware sensors Cisco Nexus Data Broker support

text.text: The two third generation Fabric Interconnect hosts the UCS Manager systems management software that monitors each element below the Top of Rack switch and can feed this information to the Azure Stack Azure Admin Portal. The full complement of UCS Manager capabilities are available to customers including Cisco’s ground breaking Service Profile capability which is extremely useful when adding a server node to a cluster.
